spec_match.rationale: Calls the real hasPrivateToken/hasRedemptionRecord query methods against a matrix of issuers — well-formed, self, insecure, malformed, path-carrying — plus a surface inventory of the whole web-facing API.

interactive.rationale: A run button executes the five-issuer matrix live and a custom-issuer input lets visitors ask about any origin; verified 3 resolved (all false) and 2 rejected with TypeErrors as designed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises poking at the shipped mechanism with no setup, which is exactly what the live calls do.

edge_cases.rationale: Insecure and malformed issuers are controls with expected rejection shapes, and the false-for-everyone privacy property is explicitly narrated rather than presented as an empty result.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6210457816924160 and Private State Tokens material.

conformance.rationale: The suite's query-methods and untrustworthy-issuer assertions are this page's exact matrix; on Chromium 141 the route ran 6 pass / 0 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): the banner confirmed the API is present, the matrix ran live (3 resolved false / 2 TypeError), and the surface inventory reported 3/3 present; console clean, desktop and mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs resolved/rejected counts per run.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, captioned results table, banner state as text, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled issuer input, captioned table with scoped headers, aria-live detail and banner text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/private-verification-tokens/tokens-that-exist-today/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), where Private State Tokens ship. All calls are real: the issuer matrix resolved false for trustworthy origins and rejected insecure/malformed ones with the expected TypeErrors, and the page's narration of why false-for-everyone is the privacy property is exactly right. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ ran 6 pass / 0 fail. Clears the bar with no follow-ups.
